name: Registered Online Safety Industry Codes (Phase 2 — Class 1C and Class 2 Material)
description: Legally enforceable Phase 2 industry codes registered by the Australian eSafety Commissioner under Part 9 of the Online Safety Act 2021 addressing Class 1C and Class 2 material (high-impact pornography, R18+/X18+ content, and self-harm/suicide themes), requiring age assurance, risk assessments, safety-by-design controls, and crisis guardrails across 8 industry sectors explicitly including conversational AI chatbots and AI companions.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by eSafety Commissioner (Australian Government) (esafety.gov.au) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within eSafety Commissioner (Australian Government) (esafety.gov.au).
